locations.rationale: This token declares the constructor parameter named title, not the Greeter instance property.
This token reads the constructor parameter title on the right-hand side of the property assignment.
This this.title member access reads the Greeter instance property established by the selected declaration.

records.rationale: The selected declaration is the title property assignment on Greeter instances. The only other access resolving to that property is this.title in greet; the same-spelled constructor parameter tokens resolve to the distinct parameter binding. No import, export, or re-export binding token names this property.
